additional_info.subject: 170003360 charger is not booting
additional_info.body:
Dear support,
I need immediate help. Im on location in Kosovo and sicharge D is not able to boot. Charger serial is 170003360.
Only once it has started to boot but stucked at 30% (loading images) for 20 min. Since that there is nothing. I have tried to update the Logo! and restarted the charger a few times.
Please send me some guidline, what to do. Im here today for few more hours if neccessarry but today I also have to commissioning another charger and fix one more which has a problem (ticket was opened today before 9:00 based on Belgrade time zone).
